title.suggested: Democrat Corrects the Republican on Allen's and Mace's Size

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat corrected the Missouri Republican's figures for the coming Allen-Mace fight, saying Mace fought at 152 to 154 pounds and stood 5 ft 9 in, and Allen stood 5 ft 10 1/2 in barefoot.

metadata.notes: Masthead: Daily Democrat, Tuesday morning, January 4, 1870.

notes: The title is the item's sarcastic heading 'A Reliable Sporting Paper', aimed at the Republican; the current title reads as if a sporting paper made the correction.
